step1_analysis.description: The circuit consists of two independent CMOS inverters. It is typically used as a differential clock buffer or to generate complementary signals in a clock multiplier path.

paper_reference.title: A 2.5GHz 2.2mW/25μW On/Off-State Power 2psrmsLong-Term-Jitter Digital Clock Multiplier with 3-Reference-Cycles Power-On Time

tpd.description: Propagation delay (average of rising and falling transitions)

sky130_expected.calculation: Delay depends on load capacitance and drive strength. For W=5u, L=0.5u and 10fF load, delay is roughly (C * VDD/2) / Idsat.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard inverter delay in 130nm with light load.
Depends on PMOS sizing and load capacitance.
Typically faster than rise time due to higher electron mobility.
Calculated based on switching frequency and load capacitance.

vth_logic.description: Logic threshold voltage (Vin where Vout = VDD/2)

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the ratio of PMOS to NMOS strength. Since Wp=Wn, NMOS is stronger, so Vth < VDD/2.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Unbalanced inverter (Wp=Wn) shifts threshold below VDD/2 (0.9V).

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure propagation delay, rise/fall times, dynamic power, and logic threshold of the dual inverter.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dual Inverter Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 OUT IN_BAR GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 OUT_BAR IN GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 OUT_BAR IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 OUT IN_BAR VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}

* Load Capacitance
C1 OUT GND 10f
C2 OUT_BAR GND 10f

* Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VIN IN 0 PULSE(0 1.8 100p 20p 20p 400p 1n) DC 0
VIN_BAR IN_BAR 0 PULSE(1.8 0 100p 20p 20p 400p 1n) DC 1.8

.control
  * DC Analysis for logic threshold
  dc VIN 0 1.8 0.01
  meas dc vth_logic when v(OUT_BAR)=0.9
  
  * Transient Analysis
  tran 1p 3n
  
  * Delay measurements (IN to OUT_BAR)
  meas tran tplh trig v(IN) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(OUT_BAR) val=0.9 rise=1
  meas tran tphl trig v(IN) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(OUT_BAR) val=0.9 fall=1
  let tpd = (tplh + tphl) / 2
  print tpd
  
  * Rise and fall times (OUT_BAR)
  meas tran trise trig v(OUT_BAR) val=0.36 rise=1 targ v(OUT_BAR) val=1.44 rise=1
  meas tran tfall trig v(OUT_BAR) val=1.44 fall=1 targ v(OUT_BAR) val=0.36 fall=1
  
  * Dynamic power measurement (average over 1 cycle from 1ns to 2ns)
  meas tran p_dyn_integ integ i(VVDD) from=1n to=2n
  let p_dyn = -p_dyn_integ * 1.8 / 1n
  print p_dyn
  
  quit
.endc
.end
